notes.subject: hapen bilong han
notes.rationale: כף i minim wanpela hapen bilong han (kav), tasol Tok Pisin i no gat wanpela tok stret

notes.subject: i kamap save
notes.rationale: נודע — pasif: 'Yahwe i mekim long ol man i save long em' o 'Yahwe i wokim kot, ol man i lukim'

notes.subject: הגיון סלה
notes.rationale: tupela mak bilong miusik i stap wantaim — Higaion (wokim tingting/bren) na Sela (bosim)

translation: Yahwe i kamap save long em i wokim kot; long wok bilong ol hapen bilong han bilong em, man nogut i kapsait long tulait. Higaion. Sela.

tokens.gloss: ol hapen bilong han bilong em
